summary: to_nice_yaml converts a variable to a YAML string via PyYAML yaml.dump; default_flow_style and allow_unicode are overridden.
questions: How do I write a variable out as readable YAML?
Which yaml.dump options does to_nice_yaml ignore?

answer_card.title: to_nice_yaml filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ data | to_nice_yaml }}` converts a variable to a YAML string with PyYAML's `yaml.dump`. `default_flow_style` and `allow_unicode` are overridden internally. More options may be available per PyYAML docs.
